# The checks a commit must have passed, in one place.
#
# This list used to live in three: `release.yml` hardcoded it, the branch
# ruleset held its own copy, and `test/governance/workflows.test.ts` asserted a
# third. Three copies of a gate is three chances for a gate to be quietly
# narrower than somebody thinks — and this repository has already been bitten by
# exactly that, with a ruleset requiring a context named `check` that no job has
# ever produced, so every pull request sat pending while thirteen real checks
# went unrequired.
#
# Two of the three read this file now. The ruleset is a GitHub setting and
# cannot, so `docs/operations/ci.md` carries the command that pushes this list
# into it, and the test below fails if the file and the workflows disagree.
#
# One name per line; `#` comments and blank lines ignored.

# ci.yml — grouped to stop paying a rounded-up billed minute per job
quality
test
pr

# security.yml
security-fallow
security-dependencies
security-container
workflow-static

# codeql.yml
security-codeql
